title: Observability conditions for neural state-space models with eigenvalues and their roots of unity
abstract: arXiv:2504.15758v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We operate through the lens of ordinary differential equations and control theory to study the concept of observability in the context of neural state-space models and the Mamba architecture. We develop strategies to enforce observability, which are tailored to a learning context, specifically where the hidden states are learnable at initial time, in conjunction to over its continuum, and high-dimensional. We also highlight our methods emphasize eigenvalues, roots of unity, or both. Our methods effectuate computational efficiency when enforcing observability, sometimes at great scale. We formulate observability conditions in machine learning based on classical control theory and discuss their computational complexity. Our nontrivial results are fivefold. translated_title: 基于特征值及其单位根的神经状态空间模型可观测性条件
translated_abstract: 我们通过常微分方程和控制理论的视角，研究神经状态空间模型和Mamba架构中的可观测性概念。我们提出了强制可观测性的策略，这些策略专为学习场景量身定制，特别是隐藏状态在初始时刻可学习、在其连续区间上可学习以及高维的情形。我们还强调我们的方法侧重于特征值、单位根，或两者兼有。我们的方法在强制可观测性时实现了计算效率，有时可在大规模下运作。我们基于经典控制理论制定了机器学习中的可观测性条件，并讨论了它们的计算复杂度。我们的非平凡结果有五个方面：我们讨论了在具有可学习矩阵且无需高精度的神经应用中通过置换实现可观测性；我们提出了基于傅里叶变换的两个结果……
tldr: 本文借助常微分方程与控制理论，为神经状态空间模型和Mamba架构提出了利用特征值和单位根来保证可观测性的高效计算策略。
en_tdlr: This paper develops computationally efficient strategies leveraging eigenvalues and roots of unity to enforce observability in neural state-space models and the Mamba architecture, through the lens of ordinary differential equations and control theory.
